chartPattern.explanation: The left shoulder formed around $413-$407 in late May/early June. The head is a low of ~$374.66 on June 10. Price is now forming the right shoulder, currently around $386.74.
chartPattern.signal: A confirmed Inverse Head and Shoulders pattern could signal a bullish reversal, indicating a potential move higher from the recent downtrend.

fundamentals.name: SPDR Gold Shares
fundamentals.longBusinessSummary: The Trust holds gold bars and from time to time, issues Baskets in exchange for deposits of gold and distributes gold in connection with redemptions of Baskets. The investment objective of the Trust is for the Shares to reflect the performance of the price of gold bullion, less the Trust’s expenses. The Sponsor believes that, for many investors, the Shares represent a cost-effective investment in gold.

news.paragraph: Gold prices experienced a sharp pop yesterday after news broke that Trump had canceled threatened military strikes on Iran, but the metal had previously hit a six-month low amid inflation concerns. Analysts are divided, with some suggesting the pullback is an entry opportunity while others believe the bottom may be near regardless of geopolitical outcomes. The recent volatility suggests traders are weighing inflation fears against de-escalating geopolitical tensions.
